recommendation: Keep the commit. It completes the missing modifier portion of the Published seed issue and is supported by later OO confirmation; a future FHIR-54620 reconciliation should treat the source as already corrected.
issue_request: FHIR-37266 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested adding ServiceRequest.focus for services whose true focus is not the patient record subject, noting that focus acts as a modifier.
initial_application: The Jira-linked PR merge 7be0569 included implementation commit 652af4826f, which added ServiceRequest.focus as Reference(Resource) 0..* but did not add isModifier or isModifierReason.
additional_context: ServiceRequest is active in source/fhir.ini, parallel Observation.focus and Procedure.focus elements are modifiers, contemporaneous Zulip discussion described ServiceRequest.focus as a modifier, and later OO issue FHIR-54620 explicitly resolved that ServiceRequest.focus will be marked as a modifier. FHIR-52916 declined adding a focus-role extension and does not affect this modifier correction.
reconciliation: Updated source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml so ServiceRequest.focus has isModifier=true and the approved reason: it changes who is the target of the request.
source_changes: source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml: added isModifier=true and isModifierReason to ServiceRequest.focus.

related_jiras.note: Later OO Resolved - change required issue explicitly confirms ServiceRequest.focus should be a modifier using the same target-changing rationale.
Later OO Resolved - No Change issue declined a focus-role extension and does not alter the modifier requirement.
